messages:
Rina Malik: hey team! thrilled to start today as a product infra engineer. i'm getting set up now — quick q on where to collect the laptop and if there's a standard dev VM image i should use? also i collect mini succulents :seedling: for desk buddies

Jasper Liu: welcome Rina :tada: laptop pickup is at People Ops (floor 2) between 9-5. i'll post the dev image link here in a sec. the standard image is 'redwood-dev-2026-v1' with python3.11 and our internal sdk.

Carlos Gomez: hi Rina 44b i'm your onboarding buddy. for VMs we recommend using the cloud devkit or the local DevContainer. If you prefer cloud, ask eng-infra for a dev pool VM. ping me if you want me to request one on your behalf. Succulents = approved.

OnboardingBot: Hello Rina Malik! You were added to channels: #product, #eng-platform, #new-hires. Onboarding checklist: https://intranet.redwood.com/checklists/1791234567. To verify access, run:
```
ssh rina@jumpbox.redwood
/opt/redwood/tools/onboard --verify
```

Jasper Liu: dev image and quick setup guide: https://internal.docs/redwood/dev-image-2026. tl;dr: clone git repo, run bootstrap, then run `make dev` inside the container. If you hit network or proxy issues, eng-infra channel is the fastest.

Maya Singh: welcome Rina! i'm on product infra as well. monday we do a 1pm sync for team intros — i'll add you. fun icebreaker: what's your desk plant name? mine is 'Phoebe' :laughing:

Rina Malik: thanks everyone! grabbing laptop at noon. Carlos, would appreciate if you could request the cloud VM. Jasper, linking to the guide now. my succulent's name will probably be 'Tiny Debug' :seedling: see you at the 1pm sync.

Carlos Gomez: VM request filed (ticket #47201). ETA 2-3 hours. Will DM credentials when ready.

Jasper Liu: if anything blocks, tag @eng-oncall or me. also welcome to the sticker stash in the main kitchen 60b
